note: County-operated RV park at the Clay County Fairgrounds (2463 SR-16 W, Green Cove Springs); gated/coded entry, big-rig friendly. Open year-round for transient stays (30-day max), closed during the spring fair (so NOT event-only camping). RV-only park with no kid amenities. RV Life 8.3*/35 reviews; Good Sam listed. Operated through the county fairgrounds office (Fairgrounds@claycountygov.com), hence ownership=local. --Claude  Hipcamp listing switched off (not bookable) as of 2026-10-10; book through the fairgrounds office by phone/email. --Claude
summary: County pages (read in a browser) confirm 48 full-service RV hookups and the fairgrounds office phone 904-284-6378 / Fairgrounds@claycountygov.com; fees left as recorded from the FY 26/27 fee schedule (2026-10-11; the PDF now 403s even in a browser). Note trimmed of the site/hookup/facility facts the fields carry and of the dead Hipcamp booking route. The county pages say nothing about selling RV nights to travellers, amperage, a dump station, laundry, or a 30-day limit.
flags: Event-only check UNCONFIRMED: every current county fairgrounds page presents the 48 RV hookups only as a facility for event renters ('Interested in hosting an event ...', 'For questions about ... RV accommodations ... contact the Parks & Recreation Department', 'Additional parking and RV accommodations may be available upon request'), and the Hipcamp listing was switched off 2026-10-10. No county page states that RV nights are sold to passing travellers outside events; only the FY 26/27 fee schedule's per-night RV hookup fee (read 2026-10-11) and the earlier note say so. Worth a phone call (904-284-6378 ext. 2) before keeping it.

Blackout dates: the county says 'The Clay County Fairgrounds is currently fully booked for all weekends in 2026. Most weekends in 2027 have also been reserved' (facility rentals), and the note says the RV park closes during the spring fair; no RV-specific blackout list is published.
